item.tib: shes rab smra ba'i seng ge'i 'byung ba me chu sgra 'khor bka' yi sgrom bu
item.coloph: sgra 'khor bka' yi sgrom bu 'di/ lha grogs smra seng ser po mngon byon skam bla ma g.yung drung rnam rgyal bka' yis bskul ngor/ dbra btsun shes rgyal bdag gis rang 'dra blo rmongs rnams la phan phyir sman ri'i bla brang du sbyar ba'o//
